paite: Saul kum sawmthum ahih in vaihawm apan a; Israelte tung ah kum nih vai ahawm in,
heading: Philistiate Toh Kidouna
english: Saul was thirty years old when he became king, and he reigned over Israel forty-two years.

paite: Saul in Israelte lak ah mi sangthum atel hi. Huai teng lak a sangnih Mikmash ah leh Bethel tang ah Saul kiang ah a-om uh. Sangkhat Benjamin gam a Gibeah ah Jonathan kiang ah a-om uh. Adang teng apuanin uah apaisak vek hi.
english: Saul chose for himself three thousand men of Israel, of which two thousand were with Saul in Michmash and in the Mount of Bethel, and one thousand were with Jonathan in Gibeah of Benjamin. He sent the rest of the people to their own tents.

paite: Jonathan in Gibeah a om Philistia galvil sepaihte ava sual hi. Huai Philistia mite'n ana za uhi. Huchi in Saul in, "Hebru mite'n na za uhen," chi in agam tengteng ah pengkul amutsak hi.
english: Jonathan struck the garrison of the Philistines that was in Geba, and the Philistines heard of it. Saul blew the trumpet throughout all the land, saying, “Let the Hebrews hear!”

paite: Israel tengteng in, Saul in Philistia galvil sepaihte asual chih leh Israelte'n leng Philistia mite huat in a-om uh chih thute ana zata uh. Huchi in mite Saul kiang ah Gilgal ah akikaikhawm uhi.
english: All Israel heard that Saul had struck the garrison of the Philistines, and also that Israel was considered an abomination to the Philistines. The people were gathered together after Saul to Gilgal.

paite: Philistia mite Israelte sual ding in akikaikhawm uhi. Kangtalai singthum, sakol tungtuangmi sangguk, mihing tuipi piau a piaunel zah mahmah a tam ahi uh. Huchi in akuantou ua, Beth-aven suahlam pang ah Mikmash ah panmun akhoh uhi.
english: The Philistines assembled themselves together to fight with Israel: thirty thousand chariots, six thousand horsemen, and people as the sand which is on the seashore in multitude. They came up and encamped in Michmash, eastward of Beth Aven.

paite: Israel mite'n umbit in a-om uh chih akitheih un, mite lah alunghimoh mahmahta ua, mite kokhuk ah, lounok ah, suangpi pang ah, kulh ah leikohawm ah akibu uhi.
english: When the men of Israel saw that they were in trouble (for the people were distressed), then the people hid themselves in caves, in thickets, in rocks, in tombs, and in pits.

paite: Hebru mi khenkhatte Jordan gal ah Gad leh Gilead gam ah atai uhi. Saul bel Gilgal ah a-om lailai a, mite'n ling kawmkawm in amah azui uhi.
english: Now some of the Hebrews had gone over the Jordan to the land of Gad and Gilead; but as for Saul, he was yet in Gilgal, and all the people followed him trembling.

paite: Samuel hun seh bang in ni sagih ataam hi. Himahleh Samuel lah Gilgal ah ahong pai kei hi. Huchi in mite'n ataizaksanta uh.
english: He stayed seven days, according to the time set by Samuel; but Samuel didn’t come to Gilgal, and the people were scattering from him.

paite: Saul in, "Haltum thillat ding leh lemna thillat dingte hiai ah ka kiang ah hon la un," achi hi. Huchi in halmang thillat alan hi.
english: Saul said, “Bring the burnt offering to me here, and the peace offerings.” He offered the burnt offering.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, halmang thillat alan khin lel a, ngai in, Samuel ahong tung hi. Amah mu ding in Saul akuan hi. Samuel in, "Bang na hih na hia?" achi hi.
english: It came to pass that as soon as he had finished offering the burnt offering, behold, Samuel came; and Saul went out to meet him, that he might greet him.

paite: Saul in, "Mite'n ahon paimangsan khin ua, nang lah niseh ni in na hong tungta kei hi. Philistia mite lah Mikmash ah akikaikhawm uh chih ka thei hi.
english: Samuel said, “What have you done?” Saul said, “Because I saw that the people were scattered from me, and that you didn’t come within the days appointed, and that the Philistines assembled themselves together at Michmash,

paite: Huaiziak in 'Philistia mite'n Gilgal ah hon sual dekdek uhi. TOUPA hehpihna lah ka ngen nai kei a,' ka chi hi. Huaiziak in halmang thillat lan lou thei ka hi kei,” achi hi.
english: therefore I said, ‘Now the Philistines will come down on me to Gilgal, and I haven’t entreated the favor of Yahweh.’ I forced myself therefore, and offered the burnt offering.”

paite: Samuel in Saul kiang ah, "Na thilhih ahaihuai mahmah hi. TOUPA na Pathian thupiak, nang thu ahon piak na zui kei hi. TOUPA'N Israelte tung ah na lalna tangtawn a hihkip tum zaw hiven maw,
english: Samuel said to Saul, “You have done foolishly. You have not kept the commandment of Yahweh your God, which he commanded you; for now Yahweh would have established your kingdom on Israel forever.

paite: Himahleh na lalna amongta ding; TOUPA'N thu ahon piak na zuih louh ziak in TOUPA'N ama lungtang bang pumi azong a, mite tung a heutu ding in TOUPA'N amah asepta hi," achi hi.
english: But now your kingdom will not continue. Yahweh has sought for himself a man after his own heart, and Yahweh has appointed him to be prince over his people, because you have not kept that which Yahweh commanded you.”

paite: Samuel athou a, Gilgal a pan Benjamin gam a Gibeah ah ahohtou hi. Saul in akiang a mi omte asim a, zaguk tak ahi uh.
heading: Galdou Ding A Kisakkholhna
english: Samuel arose, and went from Gilgal to Gibeah of Benjamin. Saul counted the people who were present with him, about six hundred men.

paite: Saul leh atapa Jonathan leh akiang ua mi omte Benjamin gam a Gibeah ah a-om uh. Himahleh Philistia mite'n Mikmash ah panmun akhoh uhi.
english: Saul, and Jonathan his son, and the people who were present with them, stayed in Geba of Benjamin; but the Philistines encamped in Michmash.

paite: Lok mite Philistia mite panmun a pan pawl thum ahong kuan ua, pawl khat in Shual gam a Ophrah lam zuan lampi azui uhi.
english: The raiders came out of the camp of the Philistines in three companies: one company turned to the way that leads to Ophrah, to the land of Shual;

paite: Pawl khat in Beth-horon lam zuan lampi azui ua, pawl dang in gamdai zul Zeboim Phaizang lam zuan gamgi lampi azui uhi.
english: another company turned the way to Beth Horon; and another company turned the way of the border that looks down on the valley of Zeboim toward the wilderness.

paite: Philistia mite'n, "Hebru mite'n namsau hiam, tei hiam abawl kha zenzen ding uh," achih ziak un Israel gam pumpi ah siksekmi akimu kei hi.
english: Now there was no blacksmith found throughout all the land of Israel, for the Philistines said, “Lest the Hebrews make themselves swords or spears”;

paite: Himahleh Israel mi tengteng, michih aleilehna, asuanggal, aheipi, atupi tat-hiam ding in, Philistiate kiang ah ahohsuk zel uhi.
english: but all the Israelites went down to the Philistines, each man to sharpen his own plowshare, mattock, ax, and sickle.

paite: Himahleh tupite, suanggalte, sikkhutte leh heipite tat-hiamna ding sik-hat leh chiang mukzumte bawlna ding anei uhi.
english: The price was one payim each to sharpen mattocks, plowshares, pitchforks, axes, and goads.

paite: Huchi in hichi ahong hi a, akidou ni un Saul leh Jonathan kiang a om mite'n namsau hiam, tei hiam anei kei uh. Saul leh atapa Jonathan in bel anei uhi.
english: So it came to pass in the day of battle that neither sword nor spear was found in the hand of any of the people who were with Saul and Jonathan; but Saul and Jonathan his son had them.

paite: Philistia galvil sepaihte Mikmash kuam ah apaikheta uhi.
english: The garrison of the Philistines went out to the pass of Michmash.
